scope: dual-core stock library and toolchain provenance

firmware_manifest.policy: The public NCS Zephyr revision is a comparison baseline, not blanket source-exact firmware authority.

liblc3.evidence: 41-function controlled comparison: pinned median 0.984 versus newer checkout 0.349; 22 tables cataloged.

tinycrypt.evidence: 27 pinned source/static-helper matches in the adoption manifest.

openamp.version: 1.4.0; v2023.04.0 lineage plus Zephyr cache integration patch
openamp.evidence: Firmware embeds the WEST_TOPDIR OpenAMP path; selected owners have relocation-normalized exact matches.

libmetal.evidence: Firmware embeds the WEST_TOPDIR libmetal path; selected owners have relocation-normalized exact matches.

hal_nordic.evidence: Firmware embeds nrfx source paths; individual configuration-dependent functions retain per-unit proof requirements.

mbedtls.evidence: API/configuration context; Nordic ALT/archive objects own the recovered implementations.

nrfxlib.evidence: Public NCS 2.5.1 manifest pin. Archive-level release discrimination is recorded separately in stock_version_precision_matrix.json; a parent revision alone is not firmware ownership proof.

cc312_platform.version: 0.9.18; archive blob is identical in sampled nrfxlib v2.5.0, v2.5.1, and v2.5.2
cc312_platform.evidence: Firmware 0x0007954c..0x0007c00c: 89 selected sections across 31 members and all 9564 unmasked bytes exact after 345 relocation normalizations. This proves the 0.9.18 member family and rejects sampled 0.9.19, but does not distinguish NCS 2.5.0/2.5.1/2.5.2.

oberon_net.version: 3.0.13 manifest archive; selected bodies do not distinguish 3.0.13 from 3.0.14
oberon_net.evidence: Nine P-256 matches in the CPUNET ownership ledger; seven normalized exact and two above 0.97. This is selected-body evidence, not whole-archive identity. The exact 3.0.13 archive blob is unchanged from sampled nrfxlib v2.4.2 through v2.5.2.

mpsl_net.version: exact archive family shared by nrfxlib v2.5.0 and v2.5.1; public manifest pin v2.5.1
mpsl_net.abi: cortex-m33 no-DSP soft-float; one obfuscated ELF
mpsl_net.evidence: The complete archive SHA-256 is identical in sampled nrfxlib v2.5.0/v2.5.1 and differs in v2.4.2, v2.5.2, and v2.6.0. Firmware ownership evidence remains the selected CPUNET signature/member matches, not the archive hash by itself.

softdevice_controller.version: exact archive family shared by nrfxlib v2.5.0 and v2.5.1; public manifest pin v2.5.1 multirole
softdevice_controller.abi: cortex-m33 no-DSP soft-float; one obfuscated ELF
softdevice_controller.evidence: The complete archive SHA-256 is identical in sampled nrfxlib v2.5.0/v2.5.1 and differs in v2.4.2, v2.5.2, and v2.6.0. There are 325 archive-family firmware matches. Private SDC identities remain report-only and are never authorized here.

toolchain.libc: per-core; legacy fields below describe CPUAPP newlib-nano
toolchain.firmware_evidence: CPUAPP has exact selected archive-member proof for hard-float newlib-nano. CPUNET separately has exact normalized public bodies and configured-reference link ownership from Picolibc; that does not prove the whole firmware archive.

net.libc: Picolibc 1.8.6 in the configured Zephyr SDK reference
net.archive_proof: exact normalized function bodies plus configured-reference selected members; no whole-firmware archive identity proof
